facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced by fact_new_2: Wayman renegotiated the bargain so the goblins wall off the stairs instead of the mound being cleared

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the bargain no longer requires clearing the mound

facts.text: Wayman Tisdale promised Snurk the Walkout never to tell King Hogboon where the Free Goblin Society's goblins are.
Under the renegotiated bargain, the Free Goblin Society agreed to wall off the Barrow Mound stairs, sealing Sir Alfred below, and keep the church, the antechamber and the statue room for themselves.
facts.uncertain_reason: The goblins agreed to build the wall but it is not shown being built.
